title: QUIC RFC 9000 Client 0-RTT Updated Transport-Parameter Packet-Use Policy Work Item
summary: Close the bounded S7P4P1 updated-value packet-use tail by adding an internal policy seam that permits remembered transport parameters in 0-RTT, rejects updated values in 0-RTT, and scopes updated values to 1-RTT packets.
planned_changes:
- Extend QuicZeroRttTransportParameterPolicy with value-source and packet-use decision types.
- Allow 0-RTT packet construction only with remembered transport-parameter values.
- Reject updated handshake and 1-RTT-frame values for 0-RTT use with PROTOCOL_VIOLATION semantics.
- Allow updated values only for 1-RTT packet construction.
- Add a server-side helper for optional PROTOCOL_VIOLATION handling when updated values are detected in 0-RTT.
- Add focused requirement-home tests for REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S7P4P1-0010 through REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-0356.
- Retarget the four requirements to focused architecture, work-item, verification, and method-level proof links.
verification_plan: Run a Release build, run the focused S7P4P1 requirement-home filter, regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage, validate SpecTrace JSON, run the full Release test suite without rebuilding, and check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
out_of_scope: 0-RTT decryption, buffering admission, or application stream delivery.
completion_notes: Completed as a focused internal packet-use policy and requirement-home proof for REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S7P4P1-0010 through REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-0356.
